title: A Dark Lab, 1895

plates.vo_land: What if you could see a living skeleton — without cutting anyone open?
plates.prompt: Animistry premium 3D cartoon. Cold open: a living human-hand silhouette as a soft green-violet glow on a dark cardboard-like plane — faint bones read through skin, no knife, no blood, no gore, no hospital. Wonder, not horror. Continuous slow push. Silent. No Explorer. No Orbit. No readable text. HARD REJECT: photoreal x-ray photo, medical gore, Ken Burns only, Periodic desk, Germs ward.

plates.prompt: Animistry premium 3D cartoon. plates.prompt: Same lab DNA. Camera hunts empty dark air just beyond the glass — something unseen about to leave. Continuous push into the dark beside the tube. Silent. HARD REJECT: cardboard glow (Part 02), bones (Part 03), Orbit, gore, photoreal.
